events.title: Death of Ludwig van Beethoven
events.description: German composer Ludwig van Beethoven died in Vienna at age 56 after a prolonged illness. His funeral procession a few days later drew thousands of mourners.
events.significance: Beethoven bridged the Classical and Romantic eras in Western music, and his late works, including the Ninth Symphony, reshaped what composers believed music could express.

events.title: Jonas Salk Announces Polio Vaccine
events.description: Dr. Jonas Salk announced on a national radio broadcast that he had successfully tested a vaccine against poliomyelitis, after trials involving his inactivated-virus approach.
events.significance: The announcement led to mass vaccination campaigns that dramatically reduced polio cases worldwide and set the stage for the near-eradication of the disease.

events.title: Bangladesh Declares Independence
events.description: Following the start of Operation Searchlight by the Pakistani military, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's declaration of independence was broadcast, and March 26 is observed as Independence Day in Bangladesh. The Bangladesh Liberation War followed.
events.significance: The declaration began a nine-month war that ended in December 1971 with the creation of Bangladesh as a sovereign state, reshaping South Asia's political map.

events.title: Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty Signed
events.description: Egyptian President Anwar Sadat and Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin signed the treaty at the White House, with U.S. President Jimmy Carter presiding, following the 1978 Camp David Accords.
events.significance: Egypt became the first Arab state to formally recognize Israel, and Israel agreed to withdraw from the Sinai Peninsula, marking a landmark in Middle East diplomacy.

events.title: Heaven's Gate Mass Suicide Discovered
events.description: Authorities discovered the bodies of 39 members of the Heaven's Gate group in a rented mansion in Rancho Santa Fe, California, who had died in a coordinated suicide linked to the approach of the Hale-Bopp comet.
events.significance: The event became one of the most notable cases of mass suicide in the United States and drew widespread attention to the dangers of high-control groups and early internet-era cult recruitment.
